arc: II — Self-Amendment & Meta-Governance (phase 2 of Arc II)
arc_description: Arc II continues ACSA (Phase 216) by adding autonomous proposal generation: ACPA analyzes CGVF fusion scores, violation telemetry, and amendment history to generate SOFT-class constitutional amendment candidates — with machine-built justification evidence — and submits them into the ACSA ratification pipeline under HUMAN-0 veto.
world_first_claim: World-first: An autonomous AI governance engine that *generates* constitutional amendment proposals from telemetry evidence — not merely processes them — with machine-computed confidence scoring, diversity enforcement, and flood protection, feeding into a live HMAC-chained amendment pipeline.

hard_invariants.description: No proposal auto-submitted to RATIFIED; HUMAN-0 gate always preserved — ACPA only reaches ACSA.PROPOSED stage
Proposal ledger entries form valid HMAC-SHA-256 chain
No ledger record mutation after write — append-only
No wall-clock injection; deterministic timestamps only
All stage transitions produce a sealed audit record
Only proposals with confidence_score >= 0.72 are submitted to ACSA; below-threshold proposals ARCHIVED
ACPA generates only SOFT-class amendments autonomously; HARD-class proposals blocked unless HUMAN-0 flag set
Every proposal cites >= 3 supporting invariant IDs
Identical proposals (same section + proposed_text hash) return existing record without duplicate write
Ledger write and state update are atomic within one operation
No two consecutive proposals may target the same constitution section within a single analysis window
Max proposals generated per analyze() call capped at 10 to prevent amendment flooding

ratification_gate_note: ACPA-HUMAN0-0: ACPA submits only to ACSA.PROPOSED — HUMAN-0 GPG ratification required for any amendment to reach RATIFIED
